mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating signal—defined as a 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over three consecutive months—indicates a weakening labor market that triggers a Fed policy pivot toward rate cuts, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in residential construction activity, measured by HOUST falling below 1600 thousand units in two consecutive months, signals a weakening housing market that triggers a broader demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based supply-side contraction and labor market stress, which signals an impending recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal fails to outperform a single-series benchmark (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 50% of interaction-triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 275.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 250k and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a labor market overheating that triggers inflationary expectations and a Fed hawkish pivot, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal fails to outperform a single-series model (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a contraction in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
